description: This file defines the 'AOR_ReportsViewDetail' class, which extends 'ViewDetail' and handles displaying detailed report views in the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for gathering report parameters, preparing data for display, and rendering report content along with associated charts and JavaScript.

classes.name: AOR_ReportsViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail responsible for preparing and displaying detailed report views including charts and parameters.

methods.name: getReportParameters
methods.description: Gathers and constructs report parameters from linked conditions and user inputs.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the display, assigns variables for templates, loads language files, and injects JavaScript for report rendering and responsiveness.
